name: Aurê y Aurá
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

earlier_scan.source_named: Only Mello 1996 genetic-affiliation study, atlases and news items in Glottolog; no phonological description of Aure/Aura stress found.

sources.citation: Bandeira, Luiza. 2009. 'Aurê-aurá'. Novo em Folha: Línguas ameaçadas de extinção no Brasil (Folha de S.Paulo), archived PDF via LALI/UFMG.
sources.note: Journalism (interview with Norval Oliveira da Silva); mentions vowel changes and evidentiality, nothing on stress.

sources.citation: Mello, Antônio Augusto Souza. 2000. Estudo histórico da família lingüística Tupí-Guaraní: aspectos fonológicos e lexicais. Tese de doutorado, Universidade Federal de Santa Catarina, Florianópolis. (§2.4.16 'Aurê e Aurá', pp.132-141; ch. conclusions p.269)
sources.note: Gives a phoneme inventory for A&A from the FUNAI wordlists and explicitly says the sources were 'transcrição fonética larga... sem muitos detalhes como acento e intonação' (p.132); no stress rule. p.269 incidental: *u > o in AUA 'ocorrendo em sílabas não acentuadas' (the change is *u > o /__CV#, i.e. the penult is treated as unstressed).

sources.citation: Mello, Antonio Augusto Souza. 1996. Genetic affiliation of the language of the Indians Aure and Aura. Opción: Revista de Ciencias Humanas y Sociales 12(19): 67-81.
sources.note: Historical-comparative classification (sound changes PTG > A&A, phonostatistics). No stress rule. One incidental remark, p.74: in *pweraβ > pwarã 'to recover' '*pw is conserved in an unstressed sylable' (i.e. the initial syllable of pwarã is unstressed, consistent with final stress).

sources.citation: FUNAI [Affonso, C.]. 1991. A questão Auré / Aurá. Informe, Belém, 9 pp. [ISA acervo 0JD00043]
sources.note: Administrative/indigenist report; nothing on phonology or stress.

sources.citation: Silva, Norval Oliveira da. 1989. Relatório de pesquisa linguística e antropológica com dois índios remanescentes, de grupo desconhecido, na região de Altamira, no Pará. Report to FUNAI (ALEM), Brasília, 14 pp. ms. [ISA acervo 0JD00042]
sources.note: No prose on stress. 'Dados linguísticos' (fls.19-27) = 260-item wordlist in Pike-style phonetic transcription WITH stress marks (ˈ before the tonic syllable); the marks sit on the final syllable in the overwhelming majority of polysyllables (abeˈbɔ 'biscoito', paˈkɔ 'banana', pařaˈtu 'copo', kuřɛˈbɛ 'cuia', kabiˈbi 'homem', hepiˈti 'sentar', popuˈã 'em pé', mamiˈõ 'mamão', daibaˈbɔ 'palha verde', takuˈi 'pedra de amolar'...), with a handful of non-final marks (e.g. deˈpipiřa 'sandália', piˈpiřa 'sapato'). This is primary data, not a statement.

sources.citation: Wikipedia (en) 'Aurê–Aurá language'; Glottolog 5.x languoid aura1243 (JSON); ISA acervo catalogue records 0JD00042/0JD00043
